us.title: Suspect in murders of 5 found dead day after their bodies were discovered
us.desc: A quintuple murder suspect was found dead inside a vehicle in Enumclaw, Washington, a day after the bodies of five people were discovered outside Portland, Oregon, authorities said.

us.title: Illinois officer convicted in Sonya Massey killing has died, lawyer says
us.desc: Sean Grayson shot Massey in July 2024 after she called 911 to report a prowler. He had been diagnosed with colon cancer, but his cause of death hasn't been released.
